notes.title: ⛩️🦇 Momo and the Mine is turning 1! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We recently celebrated the one-year anniversary of the release of our very first game, and what an incredible journey it's been so far! To celebrate, we’ve released a new update in partnership with @qubyteinteractive featuring:

🪲 Bug fixes and general improvements 🛠️
⚖️ Enhanced balance for fairer challenges ⚖️
🏆 A brand new trophy system to truly test your skills! 🏅

If you've played Momo and the Mine before, now is the perfect time to revisit it! And if you haven't tried it yet, this is the best version so far!

Download or update now!

notes.title: ⛩️ 🦇 Momo and the Mine is 20% OFF in the Made in Brazil Sale! 🇧🇷
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44455444/11ce1f76491226bce4bab7b4a489e53f5e54d82d.jpg[/img]
[b]✨ Hey everyone! ✨[/b]

From today until March 4th, Momo and the Mine is on [b]special 20% discount[/b] during Steam’s Made in Brazil Sale! 🎮🇧🇷

Take advantage of the festival to grab your copy and dive into this challenging retro adventure! ⛏️🕹️

Help this charming mole collect matchsticks in a haunted mine in this exciting platformer!

[list]
[*] ✅ Easy-to-learn gameplay with tight controls.
[*] 🎨 Beautiful pixel art graphics reminiscent of the most nostalgic 8-bit era games.
[*] 🕶️ An optional retro filter to enhance the nostalgia even more.
[*] 🎵 The best of chiptune in an immersive and memorable soundtrack.
[*] ⚔️ Play through 40 levels, including boss battles.
[*] 🐾 Cute characters and enemies.
[/list]
